chunks: Ibn Abi 'Umayr narrated from Hammad ibn 'Isa who said:

I never saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) eat while reclining. Then he remembered the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'He never ate while reclining until he passed away.'
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's and Imams' posture when eating?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Kitab al-Zuhd* by Husayn ibn Sa'id, this hadith from Ibn Abi Umayr via Hammad ibn Isa emphasizes the consistent asceticism of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking his personal habit of not eating while reclining directly to the Prophet Muhammad’s (PBUH) practice. This narration serves as a practical model of *Zuhd* (asceticism), illustrating how the Imams embodied prophetic humility in mundane acts like dining, thereby reinforcing the continuity of spiritual etiquette between the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt.
